'''Hazel's Holiday''' (Japanese: '''マロンのメリークリスマス''' ''{{tt|Marron's|Hazel's}} Merry Christmas''), is the sixth chapter of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey volume 5|fifth volume]] of [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
[[Almond]] is ditching [[Hazel]]'s [[Christmas]] party to go see a rare {{p|Dratini}} with the [[Pokémon Fan Club]]. Hazel decides she's better off without him and throws her party anyway, but the Pokémon can tell her heart isn't in it.
